explanation: The seven semesters alternate starting with Semester 2. Loads are 12, 8, 8, 16, 16, 12 and 4 units. All prerequisites are completed earlier, offerings and preclusions are respected, and CS2101/CS2103T are enrolled together. Including completed courses, the plan provides 34 breadth units, 20 upper-level breadth units, 70 programme_lower units and 6 industry units, satisfying the AI focus and all required course placements. Previously completed courses are not repeated.
